text:
sam: Quick sync 9Nimbus Insurance9 want a 3-week POC: streaming + function/tool calls to extract structured claims, SOC2 evidence for procurement, and a headline pricing estimate for a short reserved bucket. Can we assemble an engineer-facing runbook + a short pricing note to hand them?

jenna: Stack? Node + Python + small Go adapter?

sam: Correct. Frontend orchestration is Node, backend workers Python, tiny Go service for ingestion.

miguel: Is drafting a concise example for streaming + function_call that yields structured JSON. Node sample: 
```js
const stream = await client.stream({
  model: 'redwood-large-v2',
  stream: true,
  tools: [{name: 'extract_claim', spec: {input_schema: {type: 'object'}}}],
  input: 'Email body: "Customer slipped in store and broke wrist"',
  structured_output: true
});
stream.on('function_call', async (call) => {
  const toolResult = await adapter.post('/extract', {text: call.args.text});
  await stream.resume({tool_result: toolResult});
});
```
Note: prefer SSE for simpler UI integrations; websockets for bi-directional low-latency.

devon: Ops tips for POC: if docs >4k tokens enable prefix KV caching; set batch_size=1, max_concurrency=4. Use quantized variant (8-bit) for lower latency if acceptable for quality. Configure fallback policy to 'smaller-model' to avoid hard failures under contention.

priya: Security checklist to prep SOC2 responses: data residency, retention, KMS/HSM usage, subprocessors, and whether PII will be sent to hosted API. If Nimbus sends PII recommend Redwood Private (VPC) or on-prem. I can pre-fill questionnaire but need customer's security contact + sample payloads. Also suggest client-side redaction or tokenization for PII during POC.

elaine: Pricing sketch for a 3-week reserved trial: typical small POC (1-2 qps sustained) we propose a short reserved bucket ~ $6,000 plus overage at list. Offer 20% one-time POC discount if approved by deal desk and a testing credit to offset setup. If they need longer log retention or audit add-ons, those will be priced separately.

sam: Can someone confirm SSE support for streaming intermediate function_call events into the UI? Nimbus wants live partial parse updates on the claim form.

devon: SSE supports streaming text + intermediate events. For function_call flows where the runtime issues an external HTTP call, SSE can emit the function_call and subsequent tool_result events. If they need low-latency back-and-forth (tool calls that influence generation mid-stream) recommend websockets. Workaround: adapter returns quickly and we call /streams/resume with tool_result.

miguel: Caveat: when combining structured_output with tool calls, ensure schema enforcement on both model and tool side. Recommend: server-side JSON schema validation and client-side fallbacks to display raw text on schema mismatch.

jenna: I'll compile a Postman collection and small code snippets (Node + Python) for handoff.

devon: Drop-in runbook fragment: 
```yaml
POC_RUNBOOK:
  - env: set REDWOOD_API_KEY, REGION=us-west-2
  - start_stream: curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-large-v2 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"input":"...","structured_output":true}'
  - on_function_call: POST /adapter/extract -> adapter returns JSON -> POST /streams/resume with {tool_result}
  - runtime_config: batch_size=1, max_concurrency=4, prefix_kv_cache=true, fallback=smaller-model
  - traces: include X-TRACE header, set log level=warn for POC
```
That should let frontend show progressive claim fields while backend workers populate the extractor.

priya: For the questionnaire I need: 1) customer security contact 2) sample headers/payloads 3) retention requirement (>30 days?) 4) whether they require encryption in transit+at-rest with customer-managed keys.

elaine: I'll draft a 1-page pricing + SOW summary and send to Sam by EOD.

sam: Action items: Jenna -> Postman + examples by tomorrow; Miguel -> final Node + Python snippets w/toolcall by EOD; Devon -> ops runbook + runtime config; Priya -> prefilled security questionnaire template + list of customer inputs; Elaine -> pricing note + draft SOW. Target: customer-facing email in 24h. :thumbsup:

redwood-bot: Reminder: tag thread with #poc-handovers when assets are ready so sales-ops can pick up onboarding steps.

sam: Thanks all, will loop Nimbus once package is ready.
